name: Rilias II
description: Rilias II was a planet located in the galaxy. In 228 BBY, it was located with the Occlusion Zone created by the Nihil marauders. That year, the anti-Nihil operative Cair San Tekka broadcasted a message recorded by Jedi Master Avar Kriss from the central water garden.
